description.zh:
获取数据的结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如 "2006-01-02T15:05:04Z"

> 结束时间需大于起始时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. For example, "2006-01-02T15:05:04Z".

> The end time must be later than the start time.
The language. Valid values: en and zh. Default value: en.
The page number. Pages start from 1.
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.
The name of the security feature.

description.zh: 获取数据的起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。如 "2006-01-02T15:04:04Z"
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. For example, "2006-01-02T15:04:04Z".
